title: Compact-support finiteness for arbitrary finite rings and a finite-type target
statement:
Let $k$ be any field, let $Y$ be a scheme of finite type over $k$, let $X$ be a scheme and let $f:X\to Y$ be of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Suppose a compactification $c=(j,q)$ is supplied: $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{q}Y$, with $j$ an open immersion, $q$ proper and $qj=f$ [def-nagata-compactification]. Then $f$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $\Lambda$ be any finite commutative ring. On ordinary small étale sites, with module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], put $Rf_!^c=Rq_*\circ D(j_!)$, using extension by zero [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero] and ordinary total derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For every $M\in D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes],
$$Rf_!^c M\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda).$$
Moreover, there exists $N\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$, independent of $M,a,b$, such that if $\mathcal H^i(M)=0$ for $i\notin[a,b]$, then $\mathcal H^i(Rf_!^cM)=0$ for $i\notin[a,b+N]$. Neither $X$ nor $Y$ is required to be separated over $k$. No finite Tor amplitude of $M$, invertibility of the exponent of $\Lambda$, or restriction to a local coefficient ring is assumed.
